ticks.note: Deferred entry into B. Because B also has a normal incoming transition, KIELER uses a different implementation: B is entered now and only B's own immediate behaviour is suppressed (outerEntry = 0). The inner initial state's entry action does run (innerEntry = 1); a shallow `deferred` does not reach inside.
I's delayed transition fires (step1 = 1), at the normal time. Compare with the previous chart.
